verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cron trigger creation/management (hatchet-docs-16) and concurrency strategies that could serve as overlap policies (hatchet-docs-18, hatchet-docs-6), plus a TUI for real-time observability into workflows/tasks (hatchet-docs-2/14). However there is no explicit evidence of pause/resume controls for cron schedules or a dedicated view of upcoming scheduled runs. missing for 10: explicit pause/resume of cron schedules, a documented 'upcoming runs' view, and independent confirmation of these specific scheduling UX features.
